scripts.reverse: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$adbCandidates = @( (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'), (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.android\adb.exe'), 'D:\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe', 'D:\Android\sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe', 'C:\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe' ); $adbPath = (Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Path; if (-not $adbPath) { foreach ($c in $adbCandidates) { if (Test-Path $c) { $adbPath = $c; break } } } if (-not $adbPath) { Write-Warning 'adb not available or no device connected'; exit 1 } ; & $adbPath reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081; & $adbPath reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000; Write-Host 'adb reverse set for 8081 and 5000'"
